_comment: Egg for the Node Resources extension: a tiny server that reports how much memory and disk its node really has.
name: Node Probe
author: Enforcer0952@users.noreply.github.com
description: Prints the free disk space, memory and load of its node once a minute. Used by the Node Resources extension. Safe to delete together with its server.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cat > /mnt/server/nrprobe.sh <<'NRPROBE_EOF'
#!/bin/ash
# Node Resources probe. Prints one line about this machine every 60 seconds.
# It reads three files and runs df. It writes nothing and opens no ports.
trap 'exit 0' INT TERM

while :; do
    DF=$(df -P -k /home/container 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1 | tr -d '"\\')
    MEM=$(grep -E '^(MemTotal|MemFree|MemAvailable|Buffers|Cached):' /proc/meminfo 2>/dev/null | tr -s ' ' | tr '\n' ';')
    LOAD=$(cut -d ' ' -f 1-3 /proc/loadavg 2>/dev/null)
    CPUS=$(nproc 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
    echo "NRPROBE {\"v\":1,\"ts\":$(date +%s),\"cpus\":${CPUS},\"df\":\"${DF}\",\"mem\":\"${MEM}\",\"load\":\"${LOAD}\"}"
    sleep 60 &
    wait $!
done
NRPROBE_EOF
chmod 755 /mnt/server/nrprobe.sh
echo "Probe script written."
